# Gaps

- **KEYS-05** (untested; [keys.md](core/keys.md)) A global shortcut acts the moment it is pressed, wherever the keyboard focus is, except while a submap is active.
- **KEYS-07** (untested; [keys.md](core/keys.md)) While a submap is active only its own keys act. A global shortcut still acts there only if it is marked to work in submaps.
- **KEYS-20** (untested; [keys.md](core/keys.md)) The keybind search lists every bind of the mode you are in, submaps first and marked with `+`, and running a choice does what the key would.
- **KEYS-21** (untested; [keys.md](core/keys.md)) The leader modifier plus SHIFT plus `/` opens which-key from anywhere, listing the global binds or, inside a submap, that submap's.
- **KEYS-22** (untested; [keys.md](core/keys.md)) Entering a submap shows its binds in which-key.
- **KEYS-25** (untested; [keys.md](core/keys.md)) `custom/init.lua` runs after every shipped key is registered, so it can remove or replace any of them.
- **KEYS-26** (untested; [keys.md](core/keys.md)) Binding a key that already has a bind keeps both; both run when it is pressed.
